title: research_watchdog check_backend: windowed-backend idle clock runs from window open, not from when a runnable unit first existed (false positive on trainer 2026-10-25 09:27Z)
note: Evidence: incident backend:trainer@20261025T0927Z. Trainer had 0 runnable units until #20037 queued 3 at 08:55Z; the 07:00Z window-open clock (147 min) then made a unit that had waited ~32 min (one dispatch cycle) read as idle 150 min. Dispatcher fired it 09:30:47Z. Fix: carry a runnable-since stamp (e.g. last_queued_at on the unit, or a watchdog state file) and count min(since_open, since_first_runnable) in research_watchdog.check_backend windowed branch; test with a planted late-supply case.
